look.name: Neon Halo
look.description: A vivid purple blue halo eye with soft nude lips, designed to take about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Foundation, neutral medium
steps.tip: Apply a thin, even veil from the center of your face outward with a damp sponge. Keep it sheer around the nose and jaw so the skin still looks like skin.

product.name: Pro Filt'r Soft Matte Longwear Foundation

steps.title: Concealer, light neutral
steps.tip: Tap concealer under your eyes and over the age spots, then blend the edges softly so the brightening stays centered. Focus it on the puffy eye area and dark circles, but do not drag it too low.

steps.title: Eyebrows, soft arch
steps.tip: Brush the hairs upward first, then fill only the sparse gaps to keep the brow shape soft and natural. Extend the tail slightly so it frames the bold eye without looking harsh.

steps.title: Eye shadow, halo violet
steps.tip: Place the light shimmer on the inner corner and center of the lid, then pack the violet around the outer lid and under the eye. Blend the color up above the crease and keep the outer shape lifted toward the temples.

steps.title: Eyeliner, blue wing
steps.tip: Trace a thin line along the upper lashes, then flick it out just past the outer corner. Keep the wing sharp and slightly upward so it matches the lifted halo shape.

steps.title: Eyelashes, lifted outer
steps.tip: Apply the strongest mascara on the outer lashes and comb the inner lashes lighter. This keeps the eye stretched and open without hiding the bright shadow work.

steps.title: Lip color, nude mauve
steps.tip: Outline your lips softly, then fill them in with a muted mauve nude. Keep the edges blurred so the eyes stay the focus.
